name: watermate-mobile
description: WaterMate mobile application powered by Capacitor

scripts.sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.sync:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.sync:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.build:android: npm run sync:android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.build:ios: npm run sync:ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -project App.xcodeproj -scheme App -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO
